svg.title: Library / the quiet close
svg.desc: Painterly concept of the walled library close: buttressed nave with round-headed windows, square pyramid-capped tower, cream row houses, autumn trees, scholars; inset of the dark service alley behind the precinct wall.
svg.text: Inside the walled close, looking west near V6 · morning sun low from the upper left · old, apart, scholarly quiet.
INSET · SERVICE ALLEY BEHIND THE PRECINCT WALL
Nave 18 × 30 m, eaves 10 m, hipped old-tile roof to ≈ 21 m; plain stepped structural buttresses
between tall ROUND-headed windows with small leaded panes; round civic door, weathered stone plinth.
SW square tower 8 × 8 m with 60° pyramid cap to 30 m: a cap, not a spire. No tracery, no rose, no pinnacles.
Cream plaster ancillary row houses 9–11 m: dark oak frame, 40 cm jetty, shutters, old tile, offset chimneys.
Precinct wall 4 m (stone base, cream panel, coping); Library Gate 8 m with a round arch, old-tile cap.
Court kept free of stalls: flagged path, lawn plot, bench, planter, one modest lamp; moss at wet bases.
Alley: smoked oak, stained and patched plaster, puddled setts, slop gutter, broken crates, no lit lanterns;
deep shade under stacked jetties. The kept front street shows warm at the far end.
CONCEPT / NOVEMBER 2026 • PROPOSED, NOT AN ENGINE CAPTURE • PALETTE: palette.json swatches and their tints/shades • G = 10 cm / B = 200 cm
